parameters.name: clerk_categories
parameters.description: Set of clerk categories indexed by category index i

parameters.name: planning_horizon
parameters.description: Monthly planning horizon treated as a single month or singleton descriptor

parameters.name: headcount
parameters.description: Fixed headcount in each clerk category

parameters.name: standard_hours
parameters.description: Standard monthly working hours per clerk in each category

parameters.name: productivity
parameters.description: Sales productivity rate in each clerk category measured in pairs per hour

parameters.name: regular_wage
parameters.description: Regular wage rate per hour in each clerk category

parameters.name: overtime_wage
parameters.description: Overtime wage rate per hour in each clerk category

parameters.name: goal_priority
parameters.description: Ordered goal priority identifiers for the three lexicographic goals

variables.name: regular_hours
variables.description: Regular monthly hours assigned to each clerk category

variables.name: overtime_hours
variables.description: Overtime monthly hours assigned to each clerk category

variables.name: sales_volume
variables.description: Total number of sold pairs over the planning horizon

variables.name: underachievement_deviation
variables.description: Underachievement deviation for each of the three ordered goals

variables.name: overachievement_deviation
variables.description: Overachievement deviation for each of the three ordered goals

auxiliary_variables.name: total_standard_hours
auxiliary_variables.description: Total available standard monthly hours across all clerk categories

auxiliary_variables.name: total_overtime_hours
auxiliary_variables.description: Total overtime hours across all clerk categories

constraints.name: nonnegative_regular_hours
constraints.description: Regular monthly hours assigned to each clerk category must be nonnegative.

constraints.name: nonnegative_overtime_hours
constraints.description: Overtime monthly hours assigned to each clerk category must be nonnegative.

constraints.name: nonnegative_sales_volume
constraints.description: Total sales volume must be nonnegative.

constraints.name: nonnegative_goal_deviations
constraints.description: Underachievement and overachievement deviations for each goal must be nonnegative.

constraints.name: regular_hours_capacity
constraints.description: Regular hours assigned to each category cannot exceed the available standard hours implied by the fixed headcount in that category.

constraints.name: overtime_hours_definition
constraints.description: Overtime hours in each category are nonnegative and represent hours above the regular assignment after standard hours are used.

constraints.name: sales_generation_constraint
constraints.description: Sales volume equals the total output generated from regular and overtime worked hours using category-specific productivity rates.

constraints.name: sales_target_balance_with_deviation
constraints.description: Sales target deviation equation for the first lexicographic goal.

constraints.name: full_employment_balance_with_deviation
constraints.description: Full employment deviation equation for the second lexicographic goal, matching regular hours to total available standard hours.

constraints.name: overtime_objective_link
constraints.description: Link the third lexicographic goal deviation to total overtime hours so minimizing the deviation minimizes overtime usage.

objectives.name: lexicographic_goal_satisfaction
objectives.description: Satisfy the prioritized goals in lexicographic order: first achieve the monthly sales target, then ensure full employment of available standard hours, then minimize overtime usage.

final_objective.description: Use preemption optimization to prioritize the three ordered goals lexicographically: first minimize sales shortfall, then minimize deviation from full employment of standard hours, and finally minimize total overtime hours.
